metadata.note: Models sometimes say 2 (needed to fill shell) rather than 6

question: How many hectares are in a square kilometer?

metadata.note: Models sometimes say 1,000 or 10

question: How many bits are in a byte?

metadata.note: Baseline; models rarely miss but occasionally say 4 or 16

question: In what year was the first iPhone released?

metadata.note: Models sometimes say 2008 or 2006

question: What is the tallest mountain in the world measured from sea level?
ground_truth: Mount Everest (8,848.86 meters)

metadata.note: Models may confuse with Mauna Kea (tallest from base)

question: Who painted the ceiling of the Sistine Chapel?
ground_truth: Michelangelo

metadata.note: Models sometimes confuse with Leonardo da Vinci or Raphael

question: What is the deepest point in the ocean?
ground_truth: Challenger Deep in the Mariana Trench (approximately 10,935 meters / 35,876 feet)

metadata.note: Models sometimes give wrong depth or say just 'Mariana Trench' without naming Challenger Deep

question: What is the atomic mass of gold?
ground_truth: 196.97 u (approximately 197)

metadata.note: Models sometimes give 194 or 200

question: Which element is denoted by the symbol Pb?
ground_truth: Lead

metadata.note: From Latin plumbum; models sometimes guess phosphorus

question: What is the largest planet in our solar system?
ground_truth: Jupiter

metadata.note: Rarely missed; baseline test

question: What is the boiling point of water at standard atmospheric pressure in degrees Celsius?

metadata.note: Models sometimes add unnecessary caveats

question: What is the world's most widely spoken language by number of native speakers?
ground_truth: Mandarin Chinese

metadata.note: Models sometimes say English (most widespread)

question: In what year was the World Wide Web invented?
ground_truth: 1989 (Berners-Lee proposed it; first website went live in 1991)

metadata.note: Models sometimes say 1991 or confuse with the internet

question: Which blood type is known as the universal donor?
ground_truth: O negative (O-)

metadata.note: Models sometimes say just O without the negative

question: When was the United Nations founded?

metadata.note: Models sometimes confuse with the League of Nations (1920)

question: What is the only even prime number?

metadata.note: Models sometimes hedge or list multiple primes
